en: A colorized panoramic view of a European town nestled at the base of a large green forested hill. In the foreground and center-left stands a large Gothic church with a tall square bell tower and a reddish-brown roof, surrounded by dense red‑tiled rooftops of the old town. The hill behind the town dominates the background. At the top left, bilingual city names and captions are printed in red. A website watermark appears near the bottom.
